Interaction Description: The risk or severity of severe hemorrhage, bleeding, and fatal gastrointestinal bleeding can be increased when Aspirin is combined with Warfarin.
The risk or severity of fatal bleeding and severe hemorrhage can be increased when Clopidogrel is combined with Warfarin.
The risk or severity of QT prolongation, ventricular arrhythmias, and cardiotoxicity can be increased when Azithromycin is combined with Ciprofloxacin.
The risk or severity of renal failure, hyperkalemia, and severe hypertension can be increased when Ibuprofen is combined with Telmisartan.
The therapeutic efficacy of Aspirin can be decreased and the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding and nephrotoxicity can be increased when combined with Ibuprofen.
The risk or severity of rhabdomyolysis, hepatotoxicity, and adverse effects can be increased when Clarithromycin is combined with Atorvastatin.
The risk or severity of renal impairment and lactic acidosis can be increased when Ibuprofen is combined with Metformin.
The risk or severity of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis can be increased when Amlodipine is combined with Simvastatin.
The serum concentration of Warfarin can be increased when combined with prolonged Paracetamol, leading to increased risk of bleeding.
Amlodipine may increase the hypotensive activities of Telmisartan, which may cause hypotension.
The risk or severity of hypoglycemia and adverse effects can be increased when Ciprofloxacin is combined with Metformin.
The serum concentration of Warfarin can be increased when combined with Atorvastatin, altering anticoagulation.
Pantoprazole may decrease the excretion rate of Methotrexate which could result in a higher serum level and toxicity.
The risk or severity of bleeding can be increased when Clopidogrel is combined with Aspirin.
The therapeutic efficacy of Hydrochlorothiazide can be decreased and risk of renal failure increased when used with Ibuprofen.
The metabolism of Paracetamol can be decreased and renal adverse effects increased when combined with Ibuprofen.
The metabolism of Atorvastatin can be decreased when combined with Pantoprazole, altering serum concentration.
The serum concentration of Montelukast can be increased when combined with Gemfibrozil.
The serum concentration of Warfarin can be increased when combined with Azithromycin.
The therapeutic efficacy of Warfarin can be increased and bleeding risk enhanced when combined with Ciprofloxacin.
